title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Revelation 2: the words to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum and Thyatira, the first love left, Antipas, Balaam and Jezebel.

questions.text: Which assembly is addressed first in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:1 begins with the words to the angel of the assembly in Ephesus.

questions.text: What does he hold against the assembly in Ephesus?
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:4 says he has this against them, that they left their first love.

answers.text: That they left their first love
That they are poor and blind

questions.text: What will he do to the lamp stand of Ephesus unless they repent?
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:5 says he is coming swiftly and will move their lamp stand out of its place unless they repent.

answers.text: Put out its light with water
Hand it over to another assembly
Move it out of its place

questions.text: Whose works does the assembly in Ephesus hate, which he also hates?
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:6 says they hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which he also hates.

answers.text: The works of the synagogue of Satan

questions.text: How long will the assembly in Smyrna have oppression?
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:10 says the devil is about to throw some of them into prison and they will have oppression for ten days.

questions.text: Who is named as the faithful witness who was killed in Pergamum?
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:13 names Antipas, his witness and his faithful one, who was killed where Satan dwells.

questions.text: Whom did Balaam teach to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:14 says some hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel.

questions.text: What is promised to him who overcomes in the words to Pergamum?
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:17 says he will give him of the hidden manna, and a white stone with a new name written on it which no one knows but the one who receives it.

answers.text: A rod of iron to rule the nations
A pillar in the temple of his God
A crown of gold set upon his head
Hidden manna and a white stone with a new name on it

questions.text: What does the woman Jezebel in Thyatira call herself?
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:20 says he has this against them, that they tolerate the woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess.

questions.text: What will all the assemblies come to know, according to the words to Thyatira?
questions.explanation: Revelation 2:23 says all the assemblies will know that he is he who searches the minds and hearts, and that he gives to each one according to their deeds.

answers.text: That he will come to them as a thief
That he stands at the door and knocks
That he is he who searches the minds and hearts
That he has the key of David
